scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nasj/api build && pnpm --filter @nasj/web build
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages tests scripts/*.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write apps packages tests scripts/*.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nasj/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @nasj/api typecheck:test && pnpm --filter @nasj/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nasj/api test && pnpm --filter @nasj/web test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nasj/api test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && playwright test && playwright test --config playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:demo: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @nasj/contracts build && playwright test --config playwright.demo.config.ts
